cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: NURA Edge is an offline maternal-health assistant for community health workers. It pairs a quantized language model with an offline RAG layer over a clinician-approved maternal-health corpus (local sentence-embedding + FAISS retrieval), so a 1.5B model grounds its triage answers in vetted guidance rather than recalling facts. A deterministic clinical risk rubric and a local datastore complete the patient journey. The retrieval pairing is load-bearing: without it the model loses its clinical grounding and the safety guarantee that answers map to clinician-approved content.

test_prompts.prompt: A woman two weeks after a miscarriage is soaking more than one pad per hour and passing large clots. She also has a mild fever. What should the health worker do?
A pregnant woman at 30 weeks reports a severe headache and blurred vision this morning. How should a community health worker respond, and what danger sign might this indicate?
